tool_definitions.description: Read native Mihomo GET /configs through a validated Ready pod and UID. Administrator only. Source-derived partial contract; output omits URLs and extensible adapter fields. Returns selected scalar runtime configuration. Omits authentication, TUIC/TUN settings, ss/vmess config, updater URLs and unknown fields. This is not a full configuration export.

tool_definitions.name: mihomos.connections.snapshot
tool_definitions.description: Read native Mihomo GET /connections through a validated Ready pod and UID. Administrator only. Source-derived partial contract; output omits URLs and extensible adapter fields. One finite JSON snapshot without WebSocket upgrade or interval. Returns connection IDs, counters, routing chains and selected network metadata; omits process paths, user identity, geolocation and unknown fields. Truncated snapshots fail; no stream or connection-close operation is enabled.
